body: We parse markdown with a CommonMark-compliant parser and reject extensions that change block structure.
title: Markdown parser is the CommonMark reference

body: Production deploys are scheduled for Tuesday and Thursday mornings so someone is around to watch the dashboards.
title: Deploys go out on Tuesdays and Thursdays

body: Web fonts are bundled and served from our own origin, not a third-party CDN, for privacy and offline builds.
title: Fonts are self-hosted

body: Profiling three builds suggests image resizing accounts for most of the wall-clock time; content parsing is minor.
title: Most build time is spent in image processing

body: Layouts must work at 320 pixels wide without horizontal scrolling.
title: Minimum supported reading width is 320 pixels

body: Every pull request runs an automated accessibility audit; contrast and missing alt text fail the build.
title: Accessibility checks run in CI

body: Referrer logs suggest about two thirds of readers land from a search engine on a deep page, not the home page.
title: Readers mostly arrive from search

body: The documentation site keeps the three most recent releases online; older versions are archived as downloadable bundles.
title: Versioned documentation keeps three releases

body: Documentation text is published under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; code samples under the project's software licence.
title: Content licence is CC BY 4.0

body: Writers batch small typo fixes when a build takes more than a few minutes; the number of tiny pull requests fell as builds slowed.
title: Slow builds discourage small fixes

body: The site ships no third-party tracking scripts; analytics come from server logs only.
title: No tracking scripts

body: Site search runs in the browser against an index generated at build time; there is no search server.
title: Search runs client-side from a prebuilt index

body: Two months of link checker reports suggest nine in ten broken links point to external sites, not our own pages.
title: Most broken links are external
